_comment: One entry per production archive. Provenance and licence are curated by hand; measured fields are written by scripts/map_data/install_dataset.py. Whether an archive is USABLE is decided by content_verdicts.json, not by this file. Source data (map-data/source/) stays on the preparation machine.

datasets.role: FINAL — raster-dem for the Terrain style (3-D terrain + client-side hillshade from this one source)
datasets.provider: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA / European Union), AWS Open Data bucket copernicus-dem-30m
datasets.tool: scripts/map_data/build_dem_terrarium.py in ghcr.io/osgeo/gdal:ubuntu-full-3.13.2 (gdalbuildvrt → gdalwarp EPSG:3857 bilinear → terrarium RGB PNG)
datasets.resolution: 30 m source; 33.84 m/px mosaic (8225×9113) at EPSG:3857
datasets.tile_encoding: terrarium (R*256+G+B/256-32768 m; sea and no-data = 0 m)
datasets.license: Copernicus DEM — free and open; attribution required
datasets.attribution: Copernicus DEM © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
datasets.integrity: content-verified: dem archive, 1322 tiles inspected, 752 distinct. Presence and checksum alone are NOT sufficient — see Docs/89_OFFLINE_MAP_REMEDIATION.md.

datasets.provider: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA / European Union), AWS Open Data bucket sentinel-cogs
datasets.source: 12 MGRS scenes, TCI (true colour) COGs, one acquisition day
datasets.resolution: 10 m source; JPEG q85 256px tiles, EPSG:3857
datasets.license: Copernicus Sentinel data — free, full and open; attribution required

datasets.role: FINAL — Light and Dark basemaps (one archive, two palettes)
datasets.tile_encoding: gzip-compressed Mapbox Vector Tiles, OpenMapTiles schema
datasets.integrity: content-verified: vector archive, 9606 tiles inspected, 5171 distinct. Presence and checksum alone are NOT sufficient — see Docs/89_OFFLINE_MAP_REMEDIATION.md.
